articles.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., July 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- QuantumScape Corporation (NASDAQ: QS), a global leader in next-generation solid-state lithium-metal battery technology, today announced its business and financial results for the second quarter of 2026, which ended June 30.
articles.title: QuantumScape Reports Second Quarter 2026 Business and Financial Results

articles.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., July 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- QuantumScape Corporation (NASDAQ: QS), a global leader in next-generation solid-state lithium-metal battery technology, today announced it will release its 2026 second-quarter business results after market close on Wednesday, July 22, 2026.
articles.title: QuantumScape Announces Timing of Second Quarter 2026 Business Results and Webcast
